name: hermes-ui-monorepo
description: Hermes UI: a Kanban board for Hermes Agent sessions. Backend (server/), web UI (web/), mobile app (mobile-app/), shared TypeScript (shared/).

scripts.typecheck: npm -w web run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile-app run typecheck
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && npm -w web run test:ui
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
